newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Foschini falls after poor results.
newsitem.headline: Foschini falls after poor results.

text.p: Shares in South African clothing group Foschini Ltd fell sharply on Thursday on the back of the firm's poor year results.
The firm's stock fell about 12 percent, or 170 cents, to a new year low of 12.50 rand by 0750 GMT.

After the market closed on Wednesday Foschini reported a sharp slide in year attributable earnings to 77.9 cents a share from 107.4 cents before, well below analysts' forecasts of a fall to between 93.1 and 105.0 cents a share.
As is group policy, Foschini will award capitalisation shares to shareholders instead of a dividend.
The firm warned on Wednesday that it was approaching the new year with caution and it was unlikely that any earnings improvement would be seen until the second half of the financial year.
"The market is reacting to the bad news and it is no surprise the stock is falling," said one dealer.
Clothing firms have been hit hard in South Africa recently as they struggle to cope with a weak retail sector and belt-tightening consumers, hard hit by high interest rates.
